answer: Dawn Window Attestation: each identity may submit its first request of the day only within a narrow, randomly assigned slot near dawn, and the slot drifts forward each day by a per-identity offset. A record is admitted only if its arrival time falls inside its own slot; cumulative traffic must form a smooth ramp, and any burst outside a slot is discarded. Watch the ramp shape over a dune of rolling windows; deviations flag the cluster. A prism split of one identity into many requires each clone to hold a distinct slot schedule and stay idle through every other slot,
